overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the University of Oklahoma baseball team, the Sooners, for winning the 2026 NCAA Division I Baseball Championship, college baseball's top title. The resolution notes the team beat the University of North Carolina in the final game of the Men's College World Series in Omaha, Nebraska, for the program's third national title and its first since 1994. It points out that the team made the run after entering the tournament on a losing streak. The Senate thanks the coach and players for the pride they brought to the school and the state. It does not change any law or spending. As of September 16, 2026, the Senate had agreed to it.
for: Supporters say the resolution recognizes a hard-won championship and the pride it brought to the university and the state.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
